name: Noachian-Verge
description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near magnetic pole anomalies that no expedition has ever claimed.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the derelict space station in orbit left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
